name: Reflexion
titleZh: Reflexion：用语言反馈强化语言智能体
summary: The agent writes a verbal self-critique after each attempt and keeps it in an episodic memory buffer, improving on the next try with no weight updates at all.
summaryZh: 智能体每次尝试后写下自我批评，存进情景记忆缓冲区，下一次做得更好——完全不更新模型权重。
keyFact: Reflexion (Shinn et al., arXiv:2303.11366, 2023-03-20) reinforced agents through linguistic feedback rather than weight updates, and reported 91% pass@1 on HumanEval against the 80% scored by the GPT-4 baseline it compared with.
keyFactZh: Reflexion（Shinn 等，arXiv:2303.11366，2023-03-20）用语言反馈而非权重更新来强化智能体，论文报告在 HumanEval 上取得 91% pass@1，而它对照的 GPT-4 基线为 80%。
whyItMatters: This is why "reflection" and "episodic memory" are standard parts of an agent stack, and why prompt architecture can sometimes buy reliability that would otherwise require fine-tuning.
whyItMattersZh: 这正是「反思」与「情景记忆」成为 Agent 标配组件的原因，也说明有时靠提示架构就能换来本来需要微调才能得到的可靠性。
title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
